name: KeePassXC
tagline: An offline password vault in a single encrypted file
description: A desktop password manager that keeps everything in one encrypted database file in the open KDBX format. There is no account and no server; how, and whether, the file reaches your other devices is up to you.
backing: A volunteer team funded by donations

maturity.rationale: A conservative, widely trusted codebase that has passed independent security reviews, built on the KeePass format that has been in use since 2003.

strengths: No server, no account and no network connection required
The vault is one encrypted file in an open format that many other apps can read
Passkeys, one-time codes, SSH agent integration and browser autofill are included
weaknesses: Sync is up to you: put the file in Syncthing or Nextcloud and deal with the occasional conflict
Sharing with a team means sharing a file and its password; there are no per-user permissions

featureNotes.mobile-apps: Compatible apps such as KeePassDX (Android) and KeePassium (iOS)
featureNotes.built-in-sync: Sync the vault file with a tool of your choice
